title: The Nader V2
author: Anthony
desc: to make mr elie nader the jacked and stacked and mobile and pain free beast he is willing to become. my client will not be let down if he follows everything religiously especially not only in training, but in the diet and the SLEEP guys pleaseeee sleep at least 7 and up to 10 hours a night of UNINTERRUPTED good quality sleep. you are to track all your sets and either send them over or show me em and we will make adjustments if needed as time goes on. i will be present on most if not all your gym sessions if i can make it. if not it will be most sessions to train you.

ex.note: for bench press we will be learning the basics of staying tight and using reasonable leg drive. I want you to find your setup, lower with control and ALWAYS explode out on each repetition
i want the elbows tucked in or to a 45 dgree from the body and a nice pause at the bottom also try to take advantage of the dumbbells to go into more of a deep range of motion
i want a neutral back and i want your elbows to come and dig into your sides in your mind
focus on keeping your elbows high, moving the shoulder blades apart then squeezing on the concentric
squats are generally difficult to completely understand so dont be discouraged. you will either be adopting a high bar stance for quads or low bar for more glute focus and STICKING TO IT

ss.note:
superset city. do not skip these
make sure to not progress too fast on these as they are notorious for making you super sore after
lean forward while using this machine

ex.note: go down as far as possible and hold for 1 to 3 seconds and then explode up halfway and repeat
we are treating these like any other muscle group and strengthening them as such
these are to make your hips happy go nice and slow the goal isnt to progress fast on these
a machine would be nice or just use dumbbells unless youre using dumbbells on day A
go slightly wide and follow my coaching queues
seated shoulder press with a barbell
use the narrowish grip but not too narrow and do not arch your back on this movement as it will disengage the lats which are the target
make sure the arms dont swing, keep it nice and controlled
another back and shoulder mobility finisher, go light please
if you want something that hits everything go for conventional deadlift, if you want it more specific towards your erectors and glutes and hammies go for stiff leg or dumbbell rdl
these generally beat up the knees hard so go nice and slow as deep as possible with no pain and pause at the bottom for better knee adaptations
either be normal and use leg extensions OR be a masochist and use bulgarians, the choice is yours
hip mobility finisher to make your hips love you
use the regular bar attachment or rope for comfort
insanely difficult and will humble you but great for shoulder health
also known for beating up elbows so nice and slow on the way down and pause at the bottom to help elbows adapt
